Each stone boasts a distinct color and texture, inviting collectors and enthusiasts alike to appreciate their unique beauty. The Amethyst displays classic purple crystal formations, while the Green Fluorite offers translucent green hues. These stones are ideal for mineral collectors, educational displays, or as thoughtful gifts for those exploring the world of geology. With their rough-hewn surfaces and natural shapes, they provide a tactile and visually appealing addition to any display. The included clear plastic storage box ensures easy organization and display. Overall, these stones are in visible used condition, each displaying the variations and natural imperfections typical of unpolished minerals, making every piece distinct. Bent Smoking Pipe With Red Swirl Stem
Briar Wood & Acrylic, Approximately 5 Inches

Fitted with a silver-tone metal shank band and a curved mouthpiece in marbled red acrylic, it exemplifies mid-to-late 20th century pipe craftsmanship. Carved briar pipes are valued by enthusiasts for their tactile grip and heat dissipation.
Hand-carved scroll and channel texture across the rounded briar bowl

Stamped numbers 048 and 18 on shank near the band
Measures approximately 5 inches in overall length with a 1.9-inch bowl height
